transcript: I can't believe London is getting Rachel Zegler and Ben Platt in the last five years. Meanwhile, over here, we got freaking Nick Jonas. Like, this was the casting that we deserved on Broadway. Sorry, not sorry. Like, first we have an actual Jewish Jamie. What a concept. And then we have Rachel Zegler, who is maybe the most talented person working today. Also, I posted about this on the bird app, and so many people were like, oh, but Ben Platt. And we need to stop pretending that Ben Platt is not talented. Like, do I wish he would acknowledge he's a Nepo baby? Of course, but I also don't think that means that he is undeserving of his success. Like, both of these performers have individually given some of the best performances I've ever seen on stage. Ben Platt and Daveed Diggs and Rachel Zegler and Evita. And so to now have them together singing this score, which is one of the best scores ever written for musical theater. I also love that Rachel Zegler is back at the Palladium. Like, that's just her theater now. Anyways, I can't wait for this one, and I am very jealous of everyone overseas that gets to see this. Like, y'all just got the songs for a new world concert, and now you have this, too. It's just a little bit unfair, that's all I'm saying.
classificationReason: Reaction to London casting news (Rachel Zegler and Ben Platt) versus the Broadway production (Nick Jonas). No first-hand attendance; pure casting news commentary.
